notes.title: Dodge It! Online v1.0.5 update
notes.content:
- Added 3 new song to the game: Jump.ogg, Red.ogg and green.ogg made by Swampsesh check him out on spotify.
- Added a new free item in the box!
- Resolved a bug where the player could still move when choosing the game mode.
- Resolved a glitch where user could generate any item and sell it to the marketplace.

- VIP people can now earn 3X more xp for a total of 150xp with each ball forever.

Update 1.0.4

- The shop catalog is back.
- New game mode implemented named Snombie for VIP people.
- Implemented VIP icon for vip player near nametag.
- King crown awarded when user purchase vip pass.
- Added Game mode 2 in leaderboard.
- New icon for game mode 1
- New free item in the box!
- Resolved a glitch that player could not collect more than 1 diamond without all other diamond get delete.

Update 1.0.3

- Fixed a bug where chat icon dont change when message has added when the pinned chat has set
- Setting background image is not anymore transparent.
- Changed the data location of value so it take less place.
- Extented lobby area design.
- Patched a glitch to unlimited death by pressing just a key.
- Added diamond currency the store has place in construction mode for an undetermined time.
- Changed the xp to 50 for each collected green ball instead of 25.

Update 1.0.2

- The in game HUD button is now moved centered on top of the screen.
- Kill ball now detect player before kill the player.
- Resolved collision issue where the kill ball overlap with collect ball.
- Added tiktok link.
- Free monthly item location has now a dedicated place has the teleporter.

[b]Update 1.0.1[/b]

- Added Ping MS of the host when someone find a server.
- Added find server with game version.
- Removed the nightclub.
- Added a light brown color instead of white color on floor and ceiling.
- Added small camera shake on jump.
- Added password protection option for server creation.
- Added a small music track.
